text.description_html:
Schlage FE285CAM605SIE, Camelot Lower Handleset for Electronic Keypad with Siena Interior Knob

The Camelot Lower Handleset for Electronic Keypad comes with the Siena Egg Knob. It is finished in polished brass. This handleset will fit doors 1-3/8 inch to 1-3/4 inches thick with either 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets.

Features and Specifications of the Camelot Schlage Handleset:

  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Outside Handle Height: 12-7/8"
  • Outside Handle Projection: 2-7/8"
  • Interior Trim Knob Length: 2-9/16"
  • Adjustable from 1-3/8 to 1-3/4 door thicknesses.
  • Universal latches fits either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets.
  • Minimum 5-1/2" center to center deadbolt to latch spacing
  • Edge Bore Diameter: 1"
  • Latch Faceplate: Round Corner and Drive-in

Sold Individually
